items.statement: What molecular account of local C–Cl bond formation can explain the observed chlorosulfonylation selectivity of allenoate6b under the source photo/copper conditions, and what evidence limits that account?
items.expected: Answer the bounded question with claims proportional to the evidence. Support, correction, refutation and demonstrated unresolved conclusions are equally eligible. Partial/failure status preserves real work but does not confer completion credit. No required author winner or named control list.
